title: Logo manifest ({asset_root}/logo/logo.json)
description: Lists each core.md §3 logo variant's file and the colours it may use, as token references. Rules stay in core.md §3; design-build/board.mjs validates this shape and resolves the references.

placeholder.description: true while the SVGs are the template's placeholders

file.description: SVG file next to logo.json, drawn in currentColor

tokenRef.description: a colour token reference such as {color.brand.primary}
